description: Pedestrian Stops - Contact Cards is a dataset listed in City of Cincinnati open data portal (data.cincinnati-oh.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cincinnati. Data Description: This dataset captures all Cincinnati Police Department stops of pedestrians. This data includes time of incident, officer assignment, race/sex of stop subject, and outcome of the stop ("Action taken").. Individual pedestrian stops may populate multiple data rows to account for multiple outcomes: "InstanceID" is the unique identifier for every one (1) pedestrian stop. Coverage: Cincinnati. The portal files it under the category safety. Its tags are police, pedestrian, field interview, contact card, traffic. The table has 18 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cincinnati-oh-gov-portal.
